name: Production Cost Report
query:
SELECT
    lp.name AS "LHP No:Link/LHP Proses:150",
    lp.posting_date AS "Tanggal Produksi:Date:100",
    lp.process_type AS "Process Type:Link/Process Type:150",
    lp.reference_batch AS "Batch Asal:Link/Batch:150",
    lp.source_warehouse AS "Gudang Asal:Link/Warehouse:150",
    lp.target_warehouse AS "Gudang Tujuan:Link/Warehouse:150",
    lpd.output_item AS "Item Hasil:Link/Item:150",
    lpd.output_qty AS "Qty Output:Float:100",
    lpd.group_size AS "Group Size:Link/Size Group:100",
    lpd.single_size AS "Single Size:Link/Size Single:100",
    spc.direct_labour_cost AS "DL Std (Rp/kg):Currency:120",
    spc.factory_overhead_cost AS "FOH Std (Rp/kg):Currency:120",
    IFNULL(spc.direct_labour_cost, 0) * lpd.output_qty AS "Total DL (Rp):Currency:120",
    IFNULL(spc.factory_overhead_cost, 0) * lpd.output_qty AS "Total FOH (Rp):Currency:120",
    (
        SELECT valuation_rate * qty
        FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
        WHERE batch_no = lp.reference_batch
        ORDER BY posting_date DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS "DM (Rp):Currency:120",
    (
        IFNULL(spc.direct_labour_cost, 0) +
        IFNULL(spc.factory_overhead_cost, 0) +
        (
            SELECT valuation_rate
            FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
            WHERE batch_no = lp.reference_batch
            ORDER BY posting_date DESC
            LIMIT 1
        )
    ) AS "Total Cost / Kg (Rp):Currency:120",
    (lpd.output_qty * (
        IFNULL(spc.direct_labour_cost, 0) +
        IFNULL(spc.factory_overhead_cost, 0) +
        (
            SELECT valuation_rate
            FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
            WHERE batch_no = lp.reference_batch
            ORDER BY posting_date DESC
            LIMIT 1
        )
    )) AS "Total Cost Output (Rp):Currency:150",
    lp.yield_percent AS "Yield (%%):Percent:80"
FROM `tabLHP Proses` lp
LEFT JOIN `tabLHP Proses Detail` lpd ON lpd.parent = lp.name
LEFT JOIN `tabStandard Process Cost` spc ON spc.process_type = lp.process_type
WHERE 1=1
    AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR lp.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
    AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR lp.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
    AND (%(process_type)s IS NULL OR %(process_type)s = '' OR lp.process_type = %(process_type)s)
    AND (%(batch_no)s IS NULL OR %(batch_no)s = '' OR lp.batch_no = %(batch_no)s)
    AND (%(item)s IS NULL OR %(item)s = '' OR lpd.item = %(item)s)
ORDER BY lp.posting_date DESC, lp.name DESC
